# Maps changed paths to the Playwright specs a PR runs (see e2e-select.sh).
#
# One rule per line: <path-pattern> <spec-pattern>...
#   - Both sides are bash patterns matched against repo-relative paths.
#     `*` also matches `/`, so `apps/api/src/modules/auth/*` covers the
#     whole directory tree.
#   - Write a literal `[` `]` `(` `)` in a route folder as `?`:
#     `[coopSlug]` becomes `?coopSlug?`, `(auth)` becomes `?auth?`.
#   - A `-` instead of spec patterns means "no specs beyond @smoke". Use it
#     for code no spec exercises.
#   - Every rule that matches a path adds its specs. A spec pattern that
#     matches no spec file makes the script run the full suite, so a
#     renamed spec cannot drop out silently.
#
# A path no rule matches runs the full suite. To extend: add a rule for the
# new area, then run `bash .github/scripts/e2e-select.test.sh`.
# Shared code (packages/, lockfile, e2e config and helpers, this file) always
# runs the full suite; that list lives in e2e-select.sh, not here.
